source: The Wall Street Journal — U.S. Treasury Quotes
basis: WSJ Asked yield column, percent per annum, for six individually quoted Treasury securities. Not auction rates, executable quotes or constant-maturity par estimates. Bill Bid/Asked discount-rate columns are not used as yields.
selection_note: Illustrative maturity samples, not a claim that issues are on-the-run or exact constant maturities. About-one-year bill is the longest available bill in this saved table (28 October 2027). Each maturity and coupon is retained below. No interpolation or invented current quotes.
